text:
Tessa: starting a conservative rollout for feature/zipper-opt in the US change window. plan: 1% -> 4% -> 15% -> 40%. pin v5.4.0 for cohort US-west. manual holds at each gate.
Ibrahim: flag key is zipper.optimize.v5? pls paste CLI for ops.
Tessa: yes. CLI below so it's reproducible:
```bash
deploy-bot start-rollout \
  --flag zipper.optimize.v5 \
  --plan \"1@8m,4@12m,15@20m,40@10m\" \
  --pin us-west=v5.4.0 \
  --fallback v5.3.2 \
  --notes \"zipper opt: monitor p95 & 502 rate; manual holds\" 
```
deploy-bot: Rollout queued and will start in 2m. id=rb-6005550000. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/zipper-opt.
SRE_Lucy: scoping alerts to cohort=us-west. thresholds: p95 > 350ms OR 502s > 0.3% = auto-suspend + notify oncall. warming cache for cohort now.
Ibrahim: step1 (1%) applied. telemetry shows no regressions: p95 delta +5ms, 502s 0.01%.
Tessa: hold for 8m then advance to 4% if stable. leaving manual hold for 90s in case product wants to review.
SRE_Lucy: seen a small spike in a dev slice, suppressed. production cohort looks clean.
Ibrahim: advancing to 4%. will watch for any slow drifts.
Tessa: drafting release note blurb: \"zipper.optimize: staged rollout of v5.4.0 to US-west; pinned cohort; fallback v5.3.2; monitor p95 and 502 rate.\" will post to #release-notes after final 40% hold.
deploy-bot: Step3 applied: 15% to v5.4.0 for cohort=us-west. manual hold active.
Tessa: if any gate trips, use quick rollback:
```bash
deploy-bot rollback --run rb-6005550000 --to v5.3.2 --reason slo-breach
```
Ibrahim: acknowledged. keeping updates here for audit. :white_check_mark:
